Name: JerryBB's Dreamy Interior Backdrop
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#f48fb1][b]JerryBB's Dreamy Interior Backdrop[/b][/color][/size]
[size=4][color=#ce93d8][i]Goodbye, black void![/i][/color][/size]

[size=3]Inside houses and buildings, Stardew Valley draws the rooms floating in [b]pure black[/b].
This mod fills that empty space with a [color=#f8bbd0][b]soft pastel color[/b][/color] of your choice,
and can add [color=#fff59d][b]gentle twinkling sparkles[/b][/color] and [color=#b3e5fc][b]slowly drifting misty clouds[/b][/color] behind the map.[/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]What's new in 1.0.3[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]Japanese version[/b][/color] is here! Download [b]JA[/b] or [b]Mobile JA[/b]. Japanese translation by [b]jjongleee[/b]. Thank you so much![/*]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]Farm buildings[/b][/color] and [color=#f8bbd0][b]Whole town[/b][/color] (new settings, both on by default): paint only your farm buildings, or only the town. Turn off "Whole town" to paint just your farm.[/*]
[*]Black squares and lines that some retextures left at room corners are now filled.[/*]
[*]Houses and cabins are painted even when another mod makes their map much larger.[/*]
[*]Thin black strips between the upstairs and downstairs rooms are now filled.[/*]
[*]The mobile version (1.0.1) has the same fixes and new settings.[/*]
[/list][size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]What's new in 1.0.2[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]Match screen filter colors[/b][/color] (on by default): with ReShade or other screen filters, the mod checks the color that actually shows on your screen and adjusts the backdrop to match the color you picked.[/*]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]New color picker[/b][/color]: click one of the 29 swatches, or mix your own with the hue, strength and brightness bars.[/*]
[*][color=#fff59d][b]Gingham check[/b][/color] and [color=#fff59d][b]shooting stars[/b][/color]: two new background effects (off by default). They can be combined with sparkles and clouds.[/*]
[*][color=#b3e5fc][b]Paint houses with a view[/b][/color] (off by default): houses that come with their own sky or sea scenery now keep it. Turn this on to cover it with the backdrop.[/*]
[*]Building borders stay exactly as your retexture draws them, and decorations other mods draw around the map stay on top of the backdrop.[/*]
[*]Farmhouses with outdoor tiles work too; forest and garden art is not painted over.[/*]
[*]Small black squares left around some rooms are now filled.[/*]
[*]A few special places are now left as they are, such as the movie theater, the Witch's hut and Leo's treehouse.[/*]
[*]With SDV-Radiance installed, the backdrop is painted after its lighting, so rooms keep their normal brightness.[/*]
[/list][size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]What's new in 1.0.1[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Removed the [b]"Soften wall outlines"[/b] option. Wall art is never trimmed and always stays exactly as drawn.[/*]
[*]Near-black art (black marble floors, dark furniture, shadow lines inside a house) is no longer mistaken for empty space.[/*]
[*]New [color=#d1c4e9][b]Paint in map overview[/b][/color] option (on by default): the backdrop also fits the rooms when zoomed out below 75% (e.g. Infinite Zoom) or in a whole-map overview.[/*]
[*]East Scarp's theater break room is now left as it is.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Features[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]29 pastel colors[/b][/color] in four families: [color=#f8bbd0]Pink[/color], [color=#d1c4e9]Lavender[/color], [color=#b3e5fc]Sky & Mint[/color] and [color=#ffe0b2]Cream & Latte[/color]. Or mix your own with the [b]hue, strength and brightness[/b] bars.[/*]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]No black frame left behind[/b][/color]: the solid black filler tiles around rooms are painted with the same color. Map retextures that use their own dark filler color are detected automatically.[/*]
[*][color=#fff59d][b]Background effects[/b][/color] (optional): sparkles, misty clouds, a gingham check and shooting stars. Very slow and gentle, made to sit quietly behind your room.[/*]
[*][color=#fff59d][b]6 sparkle shapes[/b][/color]: Eight-ray glint, Long twinkle, Soft star, Heart, Snowflake, Glitter dust.[/*]
[*][color=#b3e5fc][b]Sparkle and cloud colors[/b][/color]: Auto (matches the background) or a fixed color, including a mixed [i]"Dreamy"[/i] cloud color.[/*]
[*]Adjustable effect [b]amount[/b] (20-200%) and [b]speed[/b] (20-300%).[/*]
[*][color=#d1c4e9][b]Same color in every house[/b][/color] (on by default): the backdrop keeps your color even in dim houses and at night, instead of being tinted by room lighting.[/*]
[*][color=#d1c4e9][b]Paint in map overview[/b][/color] (on by default): the backdrop also fits the rooms when zoomed out below 75% (e.g. Infinite Zoom) or in a whole-map overview. Turn it off if another overview or zoom mod shows it in the wrong place.[/*]
[*][color=#d1c4e9][b]Farm buildings / Whole town[/b][/color] (both on by default): choose where to paint. The farm includes the farmhouse, cellar, cabins, greenhouse, coops, barns and sheds.[/*]
[*]Wall art is never trimmed and always stays exactly as drawn. Near-black art such as black marble floors, dark furniture and shadow lines is kept as it is.[/*]
[/list][size=3][color=#bdbdbd]Outdoors and during cutscenes the game stays as it is (cutscenes can be turned on in the settings).
Mines and caves always stay as they are: the mines, Skull Cavern, the volcano, and mines and caves added by expansion mods.
Everyone uses a different mix of ReShade presets, lighting mods and retextures, so some colors may not match exactly in every setup.
Every retexture draws its borders differently, so small black spots may still remain with some combinations.[/color][/size]

[line]

[size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Requirements[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] [color=#bdbdbd](optional, for the in-game settings)[/color][/*]
[*][b]Mobile version:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15 for Android with SMAPI for Android 4.3 or newer [color=#bdbdbd](tested with SMAPI 4.3.2)[/color][/*]
[/list][size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Installation[/b][/color][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download [color=#f8bbd0][b]one[/b][/color] file: [b]EN[/b] (English), [b]KR[/b] (Korean) or [b]JA[/b] (Japanese). They are all the same mod.[/*]
[*][b]Android:[/b] download [b]Mobile EN[/b], [b]Mobile KR[/b] or [b]Mobile JA[/b] instead and put it in the Mods folder of your SMAPI launcher. Do not use it together with the PC version.[/*]
[*]Unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI. Change the color and effects in Generic Mod Config Menu, or in config.json.[/*]
[/list][size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Mobile version (Android)[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Tap a swatch to pick a color; effects and shapes are changed with the arrows on either side.[/*]
[*]The first time you enter a big house, the game may pause for a moment while the map is read.[/*]
[*]Match screen filter colors and Performance are not part of the mobile version.[/*]
[/list][size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Compatibility[/b][/color][/size]
[list]
[*]Only the empty space around indoor maps is changed. Furniture, floors, walls and lighting stay as they are.[/*]
[*]Interior and map retextures should work. If a retexture paints its empty space in an unusual color and something looks off, turn off [b]"Cover black map tiles"[/b].[/*]
[*]Remove it any time: just delete the folder.[/*]
[/list][size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Languages[/b][/color][/size]
English, Korean and Japanese (Japanese translation by [b]jjongleee[/b]).

[line]

[size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Bug reports[/b][/color][/size]
[color=#f8bbd0][b]Found a spot where the backdrop doesn't look right?[/b][/color]
Since I develop and test this mod all by myself, it isn't possible for me to test it with a lot of other mods.
If something looks off, please post a screenshot in the [b]Bugs[/b] tab or the comments and tell me:
[list]
[*]the [b]map or location[/b] where it happens[/*]
[*]the [b]house, map or retexture mods[/b] you use[/*]
[*]your [b]SMAPI log[/b] (smapi.io/log) and [b]ReShade preset[/b] name, if you use one[/*]
[/list]I'll take a look. Your reports really help!

[line]

[size=5][color=#ff6b6b][b]Translations[/b][/color][/size]
[color=#ff6b6b][b]Do not upload translations or re-uploads of this mod without my permission.
Unauthorized translations and re-uploads will be reported and taken down.[/b][/color]
If you would like to translate it, please contact me first.

[line]

[size=5][color=#f48fb1][b]Thank you[/b][/color][/size]
Big thanks to every creator who made this possible:
[list]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]ConcernedApe[/b][/color] for Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]Pathoschild[/b][/color] for SMAPI. This mod could not exist without it.[/*]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]spacechase0[/b][/color] for Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]VoyagerX[/b][/color] for the Ownglyph handwriting font used in the preview images.[/*]
[*][color=#f8bbd0][b]jjongleee[/b][/color] for the Japanese translation.[/*]
[/list][center]Thank you for downloading! If you enjoy your dreamy room, an [b]endorsement[/b] or a [b]screenshot[/b] would make me very happy.

[size=4][color=#ce93d8][i]Have a dreamy day!  - JerryBB[/i][/color][/size][/center]
